items.html: But there is always an upper coupling, and therefore the Yod does not cease from this place forever, for the second bounty cannot be without it; only the coupling is not complete for blessing and freedom, to crown the pleasant son, to couple with his bride through the Yesod, for the Righteous was lost from the destruction of the Holy Temple, and the blessed God swore that He would not enter the upper Jerusalem until he enters the lower Jerusalem.
